querystring.select: SELECT B.VENDOR_NAME AS AssetHo, A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID AS VendorParentId
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.VENDOR B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID = B.VENDOR_ID
querystring.where: WHERE A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS = N'BRANCH' AND A.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = N'ASSET_INSCO_BRANCH' AND A.VENDOR_ID = {0}
